Training · Online

Accessibility e-learning

Train all your teams, at their own pace.

Our online courses raise awareness and train large numbers of employees, each according to their role: content, design, development or project management. The modules themselves are accessible.

Request a quoteIn detail

At a glance

Format
Short online modules, available at any time
Paths
By role, from introduction to advanced level
Tracking
Your teams’ progress

Who is it for?

Large teams

Train hundreds of employees without booking a room.

Multi-site teams

The same level of training in every country.

New joiners

An onboarding module for every new recruit.

The learning paths

  1. 01IntroductionDisability, assistive technologies and the legal framework.
  2. 02Content editingHeadings, links, images, tables and documents.
  3. 03DesignContrast, typography, interactions and states.
  4. 04DevelopmentSemantic HTML, ARIA and accessible components.
  5. 05Project managementAccessibility in the project lifecycle and in procurement.
  6. 06Progress trackingA clear view of your teams’ progress.

Frequently asked questions

Are the modules accessible?

Yes: they are designed to be usable with a keyboard, a screen reader and magnification.

How long does a learning path take?

Depending on the role, from a few hours to a few days, split into short modules.

Can e-learning be combined with a trainer?

Yes: the blended format combines online modules with hands-on workshops on your own material.
